title: Coin Costs Ended The Penny And Put The Nickel On Notice
hook: Pocket change now costs more to make than its face value.
closing: Ending the penny solves one coin loss while exposing the nickel's larger problem.
question: Would you miss the penny?

segments.say: The penny program lost 86 million dollars yearly. Ending production removes the loss that finally broke the coin's case.
The penny lasted 232 years. That long history still could not outweigh its recurring cost.
A nickel costs 13.78 cents to make. The penny's exit exposes the next coin already losing value.
